verdict.rationale: Synctera documents a Webhook API that pushes subscribed platform events to integrators, and real-time internal transfers and Fedwire settlement. Nothing in the evidence shows ledger balance reads that reflect holds or pending activity, or that webhooks cover every transaction state change. The external-account balance checks via Plaid/Finicity are a different feature and earn no credit here. Missing for 10: documented available-vs-posted balances with holds and pending activity, webhook coverage of all transaction state transitions, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, the ledger is real-time and event-driven — balance reads that reflect holds and pending activity, and webhooks for every transaction state change so my system mirrors the bank exactly

citations.quote: The Webhook API enables integrators to subscribe to specific events on the Synctera platform.
With webhooks, Synctera will push updates to the integrator instead of the integrator pulling updates.
allows you to transfer funds between two Synctera accounts, in real-time.
Domestic wire transfers through the Fedwire system are processed in real-time, which means that transactions are settled immediately upon receipt.
